check_without_us: block_info on a node you chose
fetch each artifact_url and hash the bytes
digest_split_note: Every digest here is published as two 32-character halves: join them for the digest. They are split because this repository's secret gate refuses any standalone run of 64 hex characters in a committed file - a Nano seed looks exactly like one - and weakening that gate so a feed can print a digest would be the wrong trade.
read_this_first: Three claims, kept apart on purpose. A row can be settled and delivered and still say the output was unusable. Where a claim is unproven it says so.
request_context_note: request_context_sha256 is recorded and never interpreted. Two rows with one order_key and two context digests are both valid and both published: this record shows the divergence, it does not resolve it.
the_weakest_claim: accepted. The buyer attests it and the buyer can be wrong or lying. What this feed adds is that the attestation is dated against an anchor neither party chose, and that a second attestation cannot replace the first.
what_this_does_not_prove: That the buyer's judgement was correct.
That an unattested row was bad work. It may only mean nobody looked.
